data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: Probier das und sag mir, ob es ein "chef's kiss" ist.

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = ein Volltreffer. Beispiel: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
native.caption:
Was heißt “chef's kiss”?
